public_inputs.name: scope
public_inputs.constraint: bound into nullifier PRF and policy hash

public_inputs.name: credential_commitment
public_inputs.constraint: public commitment opened by credential witness

public_inputs.name: credential_epoch
public_inputs.constraint: signed credential epoch and accepted root epoch

public_inputs.name: credential_level
public_inputs.constraint: signed credential attribute in allowed catalog

public_inputs.name: reputation_bucket
public_inputs.constraint: signed credential attribute in allowed catalog

public_inputs.name: issuer_public_key_hash
public_inputs.constraint: accepted issuer key bound by root metadata

public_inputs.name: verifying_key_hash
public_inputs.constraint: SHA256 of canonical verifying key bytes

private_witness.name: circuit_native_issuer_signature
private_witness.purpose: prove accepted issuer signed credential attributes on the circuit-native curve

private_witness.name: issuer_signature_public_key
private_witness.purpose: verify the circuit-native issuer signature inside the circuit

private_witness.name: credential_opening
private_witness.purpose: open blinded credential commitment inside the circuit

private_witness.name: revocation_non_membership_witness
private_witness.purpose: prove credential is not in revocation_root

private_witness.name: signed_credential_level
private_witness.purpose: prove public credential_level is a signed attribute

private_witness.name: signed_reputation_bucket
private_witness.purpose: prove public reputation_bucket is a signed attribute

security_assertions.statement: holder has a circuit-native credential signed by an accepted issuer key
credential belongs to credential_root for credential_epoch
credential is not present in revocation_root
credential_level and reputation_bucket satisfy comment eligibility policy
nullifier_hash is derived from credential_secret, action_context and scope
credential_level and reputation_bucket are signed attributes in allowed catalogs
account identity fields are absent from public inputs and private witness
